name: Urban Forestry Challenge Fund
summary: Grants of GBP 2,000 to 100,000 for urban tree planting, urban woodland creation and greening projects in Scotland, run by community groups, charities and local authorities. The next round is expected in early 2027.

steps: Online form, completed in one sitting

applicant_types.quote: Community groups and development trusts State-funded schools and education providers Local authorities Registered charities and community interest companies

geography.quote: Projects must focus on urban areas in Scotland

access.quote: Step 3: Submit your application Ready to go? Please note the online form must be completed in one sitting

amount.quote: Small projects: £2,000 to £20,000 for local tree planting or green space improvements Larger projects: £20,000 to £100,000 for more ambitious urban forestry or woodland projects
